execution_log.summary:
Opus critic, 12 probe scripts on both bashes. BLOCKERS: a func override ending on `inherited` returns 0 where the base returned 1 (compiled trailer replaces the rc) -> pinned spelling `inherited X "$@" || rc=$?; n=$RESULT; kk._return $n; return $rc`; the follow refusal cannot live in buildArgv (it does not know its caller) -> TTail overrides toArray/toList/count; -z with several files collapses everything into ONE record (headers stay 
-terminated under -z, and -z re-delimits the INPUT) -> rc 2 with >=2 paths or verbose. MAJORS: first/each/toList also hang under follow without a stopping consumer and no kcl list stops -> run/each/first allowed, toArray/count/toList refused; the inter-file blank line is a 
 PREFIX on later headers (9 vs 7 records depending on termination); -0/+0 and the sign mean opposite things in head and tail (sign table); a 1.3x bench gate flakes (fixed ~3.9 ms wrapper cost vs ~42 ms fork) -> 1.5x interleaved medians >=15; tutil._badOut hard-codes __tu_ __tg_ -> extended in P0. MINOR/NIT: 19-digit magnitude guard; the tool stderr is unconditional and locale-quoted (named deviation, tests match a prefix); addArg -n/-c replaces lines/bytes (last flag wins, documented); tutil PLAN §7 row amended; take with several paths carries headers (parity, pinned); tail -f children must be killed in test teardown (leaked followers found on the box), poll ~1 s, no ---disable-inotify; nothing shared between the two units; --pid note; dead tgrep/PLAN.md reference fixed; every sink call guarded under set -e in 006; unterminated last NUL record pinned. Verified correct: coreutils 8.32 under both bashes, the rc table, headers shapes, CR kept + crlf, the tpipe stop path ends tail -f in ~45 ms with 143, tgrep mechanics in a prototype, take byte-identical and nested-safe, D6 + subshellOk.

Owner: start thead and ttail. GNU head/tail 8.32 measured under both bashes (rc 1 for every error incl. partial output; -n 08 decimal; head -n -2 / tail -n +2; suffixes accepted by the tool but refused by the wrapper; ==> headers <== with several files unless -q; -z NUL records; CR kept; tail -f dies on TERM with 143). PLAN.md + this ledger written; the unit reuses every tgrep decision (constructor rule, _nulDerived with the P3-F1 guard, partial-output deviation, unique one-liner instance). No code.
